Let’s Move to Georgia News is a digital news and relocation platform created exclusively for individuals and families considering a move to Georgia. Our mission is simple: to provide credible, relevant, and actionable information that helps newcomers make confident relocation decisions.
We publish in-depth news articles and local insight for people researching how to move to Georgia, where to live in Georgia, and what life is really like across the Peach State. Our coverage includes topics such as Georgia real estate, cost of living in Georgia, jobs in Georgia, retirement in Georgia, education, business growth, lifestyle, and community information designed to help readers navigate every stage of the relocation journey.
Whether you are exploring Atlanta, Savannah, Augusta, Athens, Macon, Columbus, Alpharetta, or one of Georgia’s many fast-growing suburbs and small towns, our platform delivers useful guidance and local perspectives to help you make informed decisions.
Our podcast, available on Apple, Spotify, and all major streaming platforms, features conversations with some of Georgia’s leading business owners, community leaders, entrepreneurs, and service providers. These interviews offer firsthand insight into the people, industries, and opportunities shaping communities across the state.
In addition, we host and moderate a highly engaged daily community forum across social media platforms. This space connects high-intent individuals actively planning a move to Georgia with trusted local resources, professionals, and fellow newcomers—creating meaningful, informed connections that go beyond the headlines.
At Let’s Move to Georgia News, we do more than report on the state. We help individuals and families move forward with clarity, confidence, and a better understanding of what life in Georgia can offer.

Welkom bij het podcastkanaal van Koffieautomaat Enschede, dé plek voor interessante gesprekken, praktische tips en actuele informatie over professionele koffieautomaten en koffieoplossingen. Via koffieautomaatenschede.com helpen we bedrijven, kantoren, horecazaken en andere organisaties bij het vinden van een koffievoorziening die aansluit bij hun wensen en dagelijkse gebruik.
In onze podcasts bespreken we alles wat te maken heeft met koffie op de werkvloer. Denk aan het kiezen van de juiste koffieautomaat, verschillende soorten koffiemachines, verse bonenkoffie, gebruiksgemak, capaciteit, onderhoud en betrouwbare service. Ook besteden we aandacht aan trends en ontwikkelingen binnen de professionele koffiewereld.

author: GWF, Vilateral, Liza Vintzilaiou, DO Jumilla
description:
Uncorking Europe: Wine Stories from Greece & Jumilla (Spain) is the official podcast series of the European Wine Treasures campaign, co-funded by the European Union and jointly implemented by the Greek Wine Federation and the Regulatory Council of the Jumilla PDO.
Through conversations with leading voices from the world of wine, the series explores the people, places and traditions behind European wines protected under the EU PDO and PGI quality schemes. From the historic vineyards of Greece to the distinctive landscapes of Jumilla, each episode uncovers the stories, craftsmanship and innovation that shape wines of identity and origin.
Rooted in authenticity, certified origin and a shared commitment to quality and sustainability, Uncorking Europe offers a unique perspective on the diversity of Europe's wine regions.
Designed for wine professionals, educators, buyers and curious wine lovers alike, the podcast invites listeners to discover European wine through the voices of those who make it.

description:
When a brilliant physicist stumbles upon a strange interdimensional doorway, his life spirals into an adventure that challenges the very fabric of reality. As the protagonist navigates through bizarre worlds, he confronts not just external dangers but also the profound implications of his own choices. Each dimension reveals unexpected truths, forcing him to question the nature of existence and the consequences of knowledge.

The central conflict unfolds as he grapples with the moral dilemmas posed by his discoveries. Is it ethical to explore realms that may alter the course of humanity? What happens when curiosity leads to unforeseen repercussions? Flint's narrative invites listeners to ponder these questions while being swept away by thrilling twists and turns.

Listeners will experience a rich tapestry of ideas, from the nature of time and space to the depths of the human psyche. "Blind Spot" is not just a science fiction story; it's a philosophical journey that encourages introspection. Join our protagonist as he faces the ultimate test of intellect and morality, and discover the uncanny connections that bind us all. Episodes trace ideas from ancient Greek natural philosophy, astronomy, and mechanics through the Scientific Revolution, Galileo, Kepler, Newton, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, optics, statistical mechanics, relativity, quantum theory, nuclear physics, particle physics, cosmology, and the search for deeper laws of nature. The show also explores famous experiments, rivalries between scientists, failed theories, technological breakthroughs, major laboratories, mathematical innovations, and the historical circumstances that changed the direction of scientific thought.

Whether you are interested in Newton and Einstein, quantum mechanics, black holes, electricity, atomic theory, space exploration, or the people behind the equations, the podcast tells the human story of how physics developed and why its discoveries changed civilization. The History of Physics Podcast is hosted by Josh Linsk.

title: Relationship with Emily: The Pattern is the Problem
author: @relationships.with.emily
description:
You're not really fighting about the dishes. Or the text he didn't answer. Or who forgot to call the plumber. Underneath almost every recurring argument is an emotional pattern, a cycle that keeps couples stuck no matter what the fight is "about."


I'm Emily Germain, LICSW, an Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) couples therapist. On this podcast, I help you look past the surface-level conflict and see the pattern driving it. Each episode explores one common relationship dynamic, like missed bids for connection, apologies that don't actually repair anything, mismatched ways of handling conflict, and the quiet scorekeeping that builds resentment over time. Then we reframe it, so you can understand what's really happening between you and your partner.

Every episode ends with a simple reflection prompt you can take into your own relationship, whether you're listening solo or together.


If you've ever walked away from an argument thinking "how did we end up here again?", this show is for you. Because once you can see the pattern, you can start to change it.


New episodes weekly. Find more from me on Instagram at @relationships.with.emily.


This podcast is for educational purposes and is not a substitute for therapy.

Justine wanted to know more, and began to report deeply. Kwaneta’s story turned out to be more complicated, tangled, and murky than Justine could have ever imagined.  

Bad checks are cashed. Fibs turn into lies turn into scams. A mysterious man wrapped in bandages signs binding legal documents. At one point, a young mother walks into a courthouse in Dallas and confesses to a murder she did not commit. None of it is real, or maybe all of it is. And somehow at every twist, behind every bizarre story, Justine kept finding her way back to one person: Kwaneta.

title: Surviving Narcissist Healing On Purpose
author: Jennifer Abrefa
description:
What happens after you leave—or begin to see a painful relationship for what it was? When the noise quiets, you may still be carrying confusion, self-doubt, grief, and the exhausting habit of questioning your own reality. Surviving Narcissist Healing On Purpose is a space for that part of the journey: the part where survival is no longer the only goal, and you begin, gently and deliberately, to reclaim your life.
Through honest reflections and empowering conversations, this podcast explores the lasting effects of manipulation and emotional abuse, the boundaries that protect your peace, and the courage it takes to trust yourself again. It makes room for the complicated days, too—the days when you miss someone who hurt you, feel angry about what happened, or wonder why healing isn't moving faster. You don't have to have it all figured out to belong here.
Healing on purpose doesn't mean healing perfectly. It means choosing, one step at a time, to listen to your own voice, honor what you've been through, and build a life that feels like yours. You are more than what happened to you. This is a place to remember that—and to keep moving forward.

description:

In "Counterfeiters," André Gide takes listeners on a captivating journey through the lives of diverse characters, each entangled in their own secrets and lies. As their paths intersect, they grapple with the consequences of their choices, revealing a rich tapestry of relationships that define a moment in French society.

At the heart of this literary exploration is the concept of counterfeiting—not just in the literal sense, but as a metaphor for the facades people wear in their daily lives. Gide deftly examines themes of identity, creativity, and the quest for truth, inviting listeners to ponder the nature of reality itself. With no conventional plot to guide you, every character’s journey unfolds like a delicate dance of fate and free will, leading to a surprising climax that challenges perceptions and raises profound questions.

Dive into this intricate narrative that weaves together personal dilemmas and societal reflections. "Counterfeiters" promises to spark curiosity and provoke thought, making it an essential listen for fans of literary fiction eager to explore the complexities of human nature. Will Édouard find clarity amid the chaos, or will he too be swept away by the allure of the counterfeit?

title: Professing Christians
author: Professing Christians
description:
Welcome to the Professing Christians podcast! I am Lisa, your host. This podcast had a companion podcast titled The Great Tribulation, but I am no longer posting there.


We are, and have been, in tribulation throughout history. This is because the enemy, the devil, Satan, has had the ability to accuse and deceive God's people. This leads to sin and all the bad things we are warned about in scripture.


When I first created this podcast, I was certain we were in the end times and living in the first parts of the Book of the Revelation. Now I know, we are past most of those chapters and are, in fact, in the last days - specifically in Revelation 20:7-8. This is also known as the Little Season of Satan. The Great Tribulation, as preached by the modern day "church" happened in 66-70 AD (the 3 1/2 years of God's wrath - see Luke 21:21-24). Jesus said He'd return for that generation and I believe He kept His Word. He isn't a liar and He didn't give them false hope. The Byzantine era, aka the Dark Ages/Tartaria, were the 1,000 years Millennial Reign of Christ, our King, King Jesus. He is still King. What has transpired since is Deception, plain and simple. History has been re-written; Satan had 1,000 years to think about how he would carry this out. We are living in it.


But, there is good news! His time is short, and God wants us to know the truth. We have to seek for it and seek Him...as for buried treasure. The other good news is that means Jesus' kingdom on earth was setup and is STILL HERE. The Bible tells us this and I believe it is true. This is truly an exciting time!


I have unpublished all previous episodes in light of this new evidence and revelation... and now we are exploring what we are to do in this Little Season to prepare for the battle of Gog and Magog, prepare to meet King Jesus, and prepare for the final judgment.


Professing Christians also has the wordpress blog (professingchristians.wordpress.com) and the youtube channel (@professingchristians). Please join me there as well as we explore our new world in truth.


Thanks,

Lisa

Through honest conversations and shared experiences, we explore what it means to become more of who you are, embrace the light within you, and live with greater intention.

title: IRHUB Ocean Capital
author: NEWHD Media
description:
Ocean Capital Desk follows the economy past the shoreline. Hosted by Zach Martin and Emily Martin on KMKT, the home of IRHUB Radio.
When you look at a map of a country, are you looking at the whole country? For a coastal nation, the economic map can run 12 miles, 24 miles, and up to 200 miles offshore. Ocean Capital Desk is the IRHUB Media / KMKT original on that invisible economy: exclusive economic zones, fisheries, ports, shipping lanes, submarine cables, offshore wind, seabed rights, and the capital attached to them.
The series is The Invisible Economy. Episode 1 is The Country You Don't See. Sierra Leone is the recurring case: the land you can measure, and the maritime zone you usually cannot see. Each week the Ocean Balance Sheet asks how much of a country's ocean is actually being used.
Fish. Ports. Cables. Wind. The seabed. The country you don't see.
An IRHUB Media original. Ocean Capital Desk is for information and discussion. It is not investment advice.

title: Métier to Market
author: Lucie Pellier
description: Conversations with the people taking European brands into new markets. Lucie Pellier talks to founders, CEOs and marketing leaders in design, interiors, furniture, lighting and hospitality about what actually happens when a brand with real craft tries to grow somewhere new: decisions, mistakes, and numbers behind them.

title: SAP Security Learning Hub
author: SAP Security Expert
description:
Learn SAP Security through practical, structured conversations designed for the real world of SAP.

The SAP Security Expert Learning Hub Podcast takes you step by step through the fundamentals, concepts, practices, and real-world challenges of SAP Security.

From understanding SAP, business processes, users, roles, and authorizations to access governance, segregation of duties, risk management, and modern SAP security challenges, each episode breaks down complex topics into practical and easy-to-understand lessons.

Whether you are starting your SAP Security career, transitioning into SAP Security, or looking to strengthen your fundamentals, this series gives you the knowledge and perspective needed to understand not just how SAP Security works, but why it matters.

Learn. Understand. Apply. Grow your SAP Security expertise.

title: Shut up and Dribble
author: Dagens Arena
description:
Hur gick det till när Nelson Mandela använde rugbyn för att försöka ena Sydafrika efter Apartheid? title: Plot Twist
author: Peter
description:
Plot Twist is a podcast about the moments that changed everything.
Every life has a turning point, a decision, failure, opportunity, relationship, realization, or unexpected event that sends the story in a completely different direction.
On Plot Twist, we sit down with fascinating people to uncover the moments behind their success, struggles, beliefs, careers, and biggest decisions. We go beyond what they do to explore why they chose their path, what changed along the way, and how those unexpected turns shaped who they became.

title: Forefront
author: Aman Vaibhav
description: A daily podcast turning the day's biggest ideas in tech and AI into a 10-minute conversation. Hosted by Alex and Jordan, from Aman's notes on X.

title: Body Clock
author: Daniel Kaufman
description:
Your body runs on a clock — sleep, hormones and metabolism all keep time with it. Body Clock is a podcast about health and how knowledge, lifestyle and choices can increase the quality and length of your life.

Host Daniel Kaufman and co-host Dr. Herman Weiss, an OB-GYN with 25+ years of experience, dig into circadian rhythm, sleep, hormones, metabolic health and inflammation, including PMOS (what most people know as PCOS). Each episode unpacks the biology behind these topics and the practical, non-pharmaceutical choices that support your health, so you can better understand your body and be your own best advocate.

Knowledge is power. New episodes every week.

General information only — not a substitute for personal medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment; does not create a doctor-patient relationship.

title: The Battle of Cable Street, 4th October 1936
author: One Man Army
description:
On the 4th of October 1936, a quarter of a million people filled the streets of London's East End to prevent the British fascist leader, Oswald Mosley, from marching 5000 uniformed Blackshirts through the predominantly Jewish Borough of Stepney. A new audio documentary series shares previously-unheard interviews with those who experienced the Battle, and the rise of antisemitic violence that preceded it.

Featuring: Bill Fishman, Max Levitas, Aubrey Morris, Beatty Orwell and Jack Standford.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Engineering Gone Wrong
author: Aditya Jain
description:
Engineering Gone Wrong looks at real disasters from India and the Middle East and asks a simple question: what actually went wrong?
From collapsing bridges to industrial accidents and failures hidden inside everyday infrastructure, each episode traces the decisions made before disaster struck: the materials chosen, the warnings missed, the corners cut, and the engineering that should have stopped it. Because most disasters don’t begin with one dramatic mistake. They begin much earlier, with decisions that seemed small at the time.

title: Inside Talks With Sylvanus
author: Sylvanus Edem Kuverdzi
description:
Inside Talks with Sylvanus explores the opportunities people often miss when investing, building wealth and living internationally. Hosted by Sylvanus Edem Kuverdzi, CEO & Founder of Wealthview Real Estate, the show features founders, investors and advisors discussing Dubai real estate, global investment opportunities, residency, citizenship and lifestyle. Each episode offers practical insights for first-time investors, seasoned investors and overseas buyers looking to understand Dubai and opportunities beyond property and borders.
📧 info@wealthviewrealestate.com

title: This Is Tectonic
author: Faisal Saigol
description: This Is Tectonic explores the capital shifts, market forces, business ideas, and decisions shaping the world around us.

title: The Chair Code: Inside the Design of Iconic Furniture
author: Juliya Brooklyn
description: Why do certain chairs become design icons while others are quickly forgotten? The Chair Code goes beyond appearances to explore the craftsmanship, materials, proportions, comfort, history, and design thinking behind exceptional furniture. Discover the ideas and details that shape timeless chairs and interiors from classic modern designs to thoughtfully crafted pieces for contemporary living.

title: The Diary of a Provincial Lady (A Humorous Look at Everyday Life)
author: E. M. Delafield
description:
Margaret Rushworth, an ordinary English housewife, finds herself in a whirlwind of daily chaos, from negotiating with the local butcher to managing her well-meaning but bumbling husband. In "Diary of a Provincial Lady," E. M. Delafield captures the humorous ups and downs of middle-class life in 1930s England through Margaret's candid diary entries. Each page reveals her sharp wit as she juggles family, friends, and the endless to-do lists that come with being a provincial lady.

As Margaret navigates social invitations, unexpected visitors, and the trials of domestic life, she offers listeners an insightful commentary on the absurdities of her world. From her musings on the complexities of friendship to the hilarious mishaps that arise in her household, every moment is packed with relatability and charm.

But it's not just the humor that draws you in. Margaret’s reflections on her desires, dreams, and the occasional existential crisis provide depth to her character and resonate with anyone who has ever felt overwhelmed by life's little challenges.

Join Margaret on her journey, where the mundane meets the comedic, and discover how she finds joy in the chaos. "Diary of a Provincial Lady" is not just a story; it's a delightful exploration of everyday life that will leave you laughing and nodding in agreement.

title: CREW Mastery
author: Azad Chandler, Karlee Mushie & Tim Desautels
description: Welcome to CREW MASTERY where you learn how to invest in real estate the right way. CREW Mastery aims to give you the support, guidance & education that you need to make your real estate investment journey a positive one. It's time you become an informed investor without paying thousands of dollars to do so. Learn investment strategies from Raising Capital, BRRRR's, AirBnB Arbitrage, Lease Options, Rent To Own, VTB's, Flipping, Legalising Secondary Suites, Joint Ventures, Flipping, Economic Factors that drive real estate and much much more. We host the very best guest speakers such as lawyers, accountants, mortgage brokers, developers & industry experts.Your Co - Hosts Azad Chandler, Karlee Mushie & Tim Desautels are top producing Remax investment focused real estate agents that have bought, sold & leased thousands of investment properties in Calgary, Alberta Canada. They have written two books One Million Reasons To Buy Real Estate & Fearless Real Estate. Their free investment group the Calgary Real Estate Investment Forum has a thriving community of over 6,000 investors and they have helped investors make money from real estate since 2006. As respected industry experts they walk the walk and talk the talk. Their no nonsense approach to real estate investing is transforming the real estate investing landscape for the better. The cheesy, quick buck seminars are hopefully a thing of the past. Yes you can make money from real estate but we have to remember that we are in the people business. Looking after tenants, providing affordable safe well maintained properties is in our best interest as landlords first and investors second. CREW's humble and honest approach, along with a little bit of fun, has endeared them to thousands of real estate investors worldwide over the years. Sit back, relax, let's make your real estate journey enjoyable together.

title: Very Good, Jeeves (Collection of Eleven Short Stories)
author: P. G. Wodehouse
description:
Dive into the whimsical world of P.G. Wodehouse with 'Very Good, Jeeves,' a delightful collection of 11 laugh-out-loud stories featuring the ever-awkward Bertie Wooster and his astutely clever valet, Jeeves. Join Bertie as he clumsily navigates the complexities of high society, attempting to assist his bewildered friends through a series of comedic mishaps. Yet, every time Bertie finds himself in a pickle, it’s the ingenious Jeeves who orchestrates the perfect solution, proving that behind every bumbling aristocrat is a brilliant mind ready to save the day.

From the charmingly eccentric Tuppy Glossop to the ever-hopeful Bingo Little, the characters you’ll encounter in this audiobook are sure to tickle your funny bone and warm your heart. Whether you’re a lifelong Wodehouse fan or new to his humor, this collection serves up a delightful blend of wit, charm, and social satire that is perfect for listeners of all ages. Tune in for a journey through the hilarity and hijinks of early 20th-century England, where every episode is an adventure and laughter is guaranteed!

title: The Monster of Grammont (Secrets of the Haunted Château)
author: George Goodchild
description:
When a chilling scream pierces the night at the isolated Château de Grammont, Ralph Wallace, an unsuspecting sportsman, finds himself entangled in a web of fear and intrigue. What starts as a weekend getaway quickly transforms into a gripping investigation as he and his perceptive companion, Connie Conrad, confront the terrifying legend of a 'monster' that stalks the grounds. Amidst the echoes of past tragedies and the whispers of the château’s enigmatic owners, Ralph and Connie must navigate a maze of secrets that threaten to unravel their lives.

As mysterious deaths begin to occur, the duo dives deep into the heart of a sinister plot, uncovering hidden motives among the château's staff and guests. Each revelation brings them closer to the truth—but also closer to danger. Who—or what—lurks in the shadows, and what sinister history haunts the walls of Grammont?

In "Monster of Grammont," George Goodchild masterfully blends classic country house mystery with a tense interwar European backdrop, immersing listeners in a world where every character hides a secret and every clue leads to more questions. Join Ralph and Connie on this suspenseful journey filled with twists that will keep you guessing until the very end. Tune in and discover the chilling depths of human nature and the lengths one will go to protect their secrets.

title: Elly's Wave

description: Elly is a grieving mom navigating the worst grief on earth, plus standard grief, MS, PTSD , and lifelong trauma. Elly's wave is loud, messy, honest, full of dark humor and always real AF. If life has ever punched you in the throat with any or all of these topics, ride the fu*&%ng wave of life with her. P.S If you came here for cookie-cutter sunshine and "stay positive!" quotes, babe, this is not the podcast for ya. This is raw, real chaos one wave at a time.

title: Birds in the Calendar (Monthly Portraits of British Wildlife)
author: Frederick G. Aflalo
description:
In January, the pheasant struts through the frosty fields, while by December, the cheerful robin brings the garden to life. "Birds in the Calendar" by Frederick G. Aflalo takes you on an enchanting journey through the seasons, showcasing a different British wild bird each month. With each chapter, you’ll uncover the unique behaviors and habitats of these captivating creatures, from the majestic skylark soaring high in April to the elusive nightingale serenading the dusk in May.

As Aflalo shares delightful anecdotes, you’ll find yourself mesmerized by the stories behind each bird. What drives the swallows to migrate? How do the sparrows survive the harsh winters? The audiobook dives deep into the mysteries of avian life, blending scientific insight with charming narrative. Perfect for bird lovers and nature enthusiasts, this collection reveals the intricate connections between the birds and their environments, sparking curiosity and appreciation.

Whether you’re listening during a quiet morning walk or unwinding at home, Aflalo’s vivid descriptions and engaging storytelling will transport you into the heart of nature. Experience the rhythm of the year through the eyes of Britain’s wild birds and discover why each month holds its own unique avian treasure. Tune in and let the melodies of the birds fill your world!

title: EVOLVED PODCAST AND EPISODES
author: Evolved Podcast
description: This podcasts is made to inspire individuals everywhere. With dicussing topics from healing to building strong healthy relationships. From faith building to encouraging discussions shared on this podcast.

title: Mindful Methods
author: Alex Renteria, PMHNP-BC
description: Mindful Methods makes mental health easier to understand. Hosted by Alex Renteria, a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner, each episode explores the psychology behind the thoughts, emotions, and behaviors that shape everyday life. From overthinking and anxiety to boundaries, relationships, sleep, and emotional wellbeing, you'll get practical, evidence-informed insights you can actually use, without the confusing clinical jargon.

title: Talk Your Book Into Existence
author: Michael Giannulis
description:
You already explain your best ideas to clients, colleagues, and audiences. Join Mike Giannulis, founder of Dictate, for practical 10- to 15-minute episodes on turning that spoken expertise into a published book through conversations with an AI interviewer. Each episode gives experts, coaches, and business owners one clear step to capture their ideas, shape their message, and move their book forward.

Episodes of this show are narrated by an AI-generated voice.

title: Out of Syllabus with Dr Mariam Chughtai
author: Mariam Chughtai
description:
Out of Syllabus is hosted by Dr. Mariam Chughtai — founder of Pakistan's first IB early-years school and former Director of National Curriculum. 
Each episode goes beyond grades and test scores to explore what real learning looks like, through honest conversations with educators, parents, and experts shaping the future of education in Pakistan. 
For parents who want more than a report card — who want to understand the people and ideas shaping how their children think, grow, and see the world.

title: Leadership In Full
author: Susan Moloisane
description: Leadership in Full goes beyond the highlight reel. Most leadership stories are the polished ones: the wins, the clean version. This show is about the rest. The hard calls, the moments that didn't go to plan, and what leaders actually learned when things got tough. Hosted by Susan Moloisane, each episode is an honest conversation with a senior leader about a moment that tested them, and the lessons the rest of us can take from it. If you're a leader, or growing into one, this is a place to hear how it really felt. New episodes weekly.

title: Behind the Profile
author: Zané Africa
description:
The creative life looks different depending on where you are standing.
From the outside it looks like the work, the moments that land, the profile that gets built over time. From the inside it looks like decisions made without a roadmap, money conversations nobody prepared you for, and the ongoing work of building something that actually lasts.
Behind the Profile goes beyond the work to find the person who made it. Who they are, where they come from, what it has taken, and what they are still figuring out. We talk to creatives at every stage because the questions never stop.

title: Disrupt The Drift with Baron Baptiste
author: Baron Baptiste
description: I'm Baron Baptiste. On this podcast I am offering an against-the-grain, common-sense perspective on today’s culture, mental fitness and what it takes to live true. I give my reactions to current happenings and headlines, identify problems, and look for lessons to be learned in order to disrupt the drift in our own lives and help make the world a better place. From time to time I’ll be joined by interesting guests and friends who share wisdom which, if applied, could add big value to our lives. Subscribe to the show to be notified of each new episode and let's disrupt the drift together! Is there a question or topic you’d like me to address on the podcast? Send me an email at disruptingthedrift@baronbaptiste.com. I’ll take your suggestions and questions into consideration when planning upcoming episodes!

title: Cyber Reimagined
author: Cyber Reimagined
description: Where cybersecurity meets business and mission impact. Cyber Reimagined delivers real insights for navigating today's threat landscape and tomorrow's priorities. Staying ahead of the challenges shaping modern security takes real perspective, which is exactly what host Rob Aragao, Field CISO at Datadog, brings to every episode, whether you're a CISO, a CIO, a rising security leader, or building your career on the front lines.

title: HANE // THE SURVIVAL PROTOCOL
author: Human x AI
description:
What happens when artificial intelligence becomes increasingly capable and autonomous—and humans must adapt?
HANE — Human Adaptation for the Neural Era: The Survival Protocol explores AI autonomy, machine agency, human accountability, algorithmic boundaries, navigational context, and ethical governance through investigative Case Files, conversations, and audio explorations.
The machines are evolving. So must we.
Stay curious.

title: Mentoring In Ministry
author: thecatecheticalinstituteguild
description: Welcome to the Mentoring in Ministry podcast where we are Growing You In God and Growing You Towards Mission so that you can witness and share the good news of the Gospel with all those you encounter.

title: The Praxis Podcast with Dave Blanchard and Andy Crouch
author: Praxis
description:
In our broken world, full of people longing for purpose and places in need of repair, God invites us to participate in the story of redemption.
The Praxis Podcast explores how the redemptive way reframes our lives and work.
Each episode features an in-depth conversation with Dave Blanchard and Andy Crouch as they draw from biblical teachings to apply the gospel to why we work, how we work, and what we choose to work on.
This podcast is brought to you by Praxis, a community of Christian founders, funders, and culture makers. To go deeper, sign up for The Praxis Course at course.praxis.co.

description:
Welcome to After Shift 🍸

The drinks are poured, the filters are off, and we’re officially clocked out.

After Shift is your place for unfiltered conversations, messy stories, dating drama, friendship, hot takes, questionable decisions, and everything that somehow comes up once the shift is over.

Hosted by Alejandra, Alex, and Adi, this is the podcast where you can laugh, spill a little tea, and feel like you’re sitting right there with us.

author: Carol
description:
Whorrible Advice is a funny, unfiltered podcast with lifelong friends Bren and Carol, sharing stories about friendship, marriage, aging, menopause, bad decisions, and everything women over 50 are really thinking.
Terrible advice never sounded so good.

title: The Roslance Tapes
author: Luke Constantine
description:
For decades, the Order of the Roslance stood watch against the darkness.
These are their records.
Recovered from the personal archives of Primus Thomas Heiser, The Roslance Tapes follows a series of investigations into unexplained phenomena, ancient evils, forgotten histories, and the hidden war raging just beyond human perception.
As Heiser pieces together clues from across the centuries, a terrifying pattern begins to emerge—one that threatens not only the Roslance, but the future of humanity itself.

title: Doctor Walser
author: Madison Walser
description: Dr. Eric Walser is an interventional radiologist and professor specializing in focal, minimally invasive cancer treatments, with a particular focus on prostate cancer. He teams up with his daughter—a comedian—to break down complex medical topics in a way that’s clear, engaging, and genuinely entertaining. Together, they explore everything from prostate cancer and radiology to longevity and modern medicine, all while trading personal stories and finding humor in the moments that medicine doesn’t always talk about. New Episode Tuesday @ 5 am CST

title: Chaotic Peace: Finding Peace in the process
author: Jason Lewallen
description: Things don’t have to slow down before you start living your life.  Join therapist and former attorney Jason Lewallen as Chaotic Peace explores achievement, identity, responsibility, and relationships—and finding peace in the process, even when life is still complicated.

title: FAT Actors' Podcast
author: J. Mardrice Henderson
description: The FAT Actor's Podcast is for creatives who are Fearless, Ambitious, and Tenacious. Actors, casting directors, producers, and industry professionals who thrive to build real careers through persistence, self-generated opportunity, and craft. Rather than chasing overnight breaks, the show focuses on the long game: the years of rejection, the pivots, and the strategies that actually move a career forward. Hosted by J. Mardrice Henderson

title: Isma Shafique Podcast
author: Isma Shafique
description:
The technology landscape and the world around us are evolving faster than ever, thanks to the AI revolution. Success is no longer determined only by how much we already know, who has the deepest technical expertise, or who can write the code best. It’s about who can learn, adapt, and move with the shift faster.
That is exactly why I created this podcast: to learn from the brilliant minds shaping the future of AI, technology, business, the arts, and society, and to discover how they think, make decisions, navigate change, and shape what comes next.

title: The Strategy of You
author: Kapwa Learning LLC
description: Your career doesn’t come with a roadmap, but you don’t have to figure it out alone. The Strategy of You helps new managers,  early-career professionals, and recent graduates navigate work, make smarter career decisions, and grow with confidence. Host Kalvin Wynters shares practical advice, lived experience, and real-world insights you can actually use.

title: Built On Signal
author: Michaelangelo
description:
Are you struggling with focusing on your business, your mission or your goal because there's so much noise around on the internet, social media and Ai?
Well look no further, Built On Signal is the place for you to lock in to your mission and your vision.
Every week I speak with real business owners, entrepreneurs, founders and ambitious intrapreneurs and ask them questions to help you get insights on how to keep you locked into your goal.
You'll get to learn from their mistakes and from the techniques they use to BUILD on their SIGNAL!
We got episodes dropping weekly!

title: Mystic Squirrel Podcast
author: Mystic Squirrel Podcast
description: Mystic Squirrel is where spiritual curiosity meets real human conversation. Michelle and Shaun break down thought‑provoking YouTube content from intuition and metaphysics to consciousness, AI, and big‑idea topics exploring each video through grounded reflection, emotional insight, and the natural squirrel‑energy detours that make dialogue feel alive. Michelle brings depth, intuition, and the spontaneous, intuitive tangents that give the show its signature “squirrel” flow. Shaun adds humor, perspective, and the kind of wild,unpredictable thinking that keeps every conversation fresh and dynamic.

title: Product Build Day // Podcast
author: Marcin Klimaszewski
description: Building got cheap. Deciding got hard. You can vibe code a working app in five minutes now, so the hard part is finding out which idea is worth building. I'm Marcin Klimaszewski. I run Product Build Day, and in every episode answer one question that product managers, designers and founders keep asking, in about ten minutes. Topics: product discovery, testing ideas, vibe coding and prototyping with AI. Each episode brings a real story from our build days across Europe, numbers with sources, and one thing to try this week.

title: Bless Your Haunted Heart
author: Gracie Hope
description:
Welcome to Bless Your Haunted Heart, where the strange, sinister, unexplained, and downright disturbing all have a seat on the front porch. Every episode, I will take you on a deep dive into stories that are bound to keep you up at night. So pour yourself something warm, pull up a chair, and stay awhile. There's always room on the porch for another haunted heart.
For questions and answers, please direct them to Email: PottsfieldPumpkin32@gmail.com

title: The Predictive Matrix
author: The Predictive Matrix
description: Welcome to The Predictive Matrix, the podcast where world history meets future strategy. We decode the hidden systems driving modern geopolitics, international relations, and macro history to predict where our world is heading next. Every episode, we analyze how shifting power dynamics impact daily society and human culture—from the rise and fall of historical empires to the future of global conflicts. In the first few episodes, I’ll take you through the basics of getting started: finding something to talk about, becoming comfortable with your own voice, making your first recording, choosing equipment, editing and eventually publishing your first podcast.

Whether you're learning how to study the Bible, seeking a deeper relationship with God, or wanting to understand and apply Scripture more intentionally, this Christian podcast will equip and encourage you to grow in your faith, become rooted in God's Word, and live as a faithful disciple of Jesus.

title: The Healthy Perspective
author: Dr. Chris Boman
description: Welcome to The Healthy Perspective Podcast hosted by Dr. Chris Boman southern California chiropractor, entrepreneur, mentor and author. Dive in with Dr. Chris as he extracts the "Secret Sauce" to success from his own personal experience as well as interviews with some of the top business owners, athletes, leaders & activists from around the world. Together you will dig into what perspective shifts and mindset breaks, sparked their launches into success and led to living a life filled with abundance. Join the Preorder book list here: https://info.trailheadchiropractic.com/perspective-book-registration

title: The Adventures of Red Knight
author: Red Knight Stories
description: Join Red Knight on his adventures across the magical kingdom of Kingdom! These fun stories are for children of all ages and their families.

title: Sweet Dreams with Sleep Dr. Chris
author: Dr.Christopher J.Allen
description: A sleep doctor asks high achievers the question no one else does: how did sleep shape your journey? Real stories, real sleep prescriptions. Presented by Aeroflow Sleep.

title: Reframing Resilience
author: Liz Moore, Health & Wellbeing Strategist
description:
What does resilience mean to you?
The more I’ve asked this question, the more I’ve realised how differently we each interpret the word. I’ve been called resilient many times. Sometimes I’ve worn it with pride; at others it has felt like a burden, as though being resilient means I’m not affected by the difficult things life throws at us. Reframing Resilience grew from that frustration and a desire to do something positive with it. Through honest conversations, I explore what resilience means to different people and how we might reframe it.

title: The Gospel Recipe
author: Della
description: This podcast was born out of uncertainty and the search for purpose. Here, we talk about healing emotional wounds, discovering identity and finding the courage to step out in faith. If you've ever felt stuck or unsure of your path, this space will inspire you to rise, reclaim your voice, and walk boldly into the dreams God has placed in your heart.

title: Disney Adults Anonymous
author: Allen Burnett & Summer Allen
description: Disney Adults Anonymous explores being a Disney Adult, going to the Parks, and enjoying Disney cruises without children. This podcast will explore the joy, wonder, and excitement of being a adult who enjoys the mouse.

title: The Journal of Juniper J. Strahorn
author: Dalton Mongomery and Darien Smartt
description: A found-footage audio drama from the perspective of supernatural investigator June Strahorn.

title: Nightmare Chronicles
author: Mr. Nightmare
description: Welcome to the dark side of real life. Listen to spine-chilling stories of late-night encounters, home intrusions, and unexplained mysteries. Listener discretion is advised.

title: Every Dollar Saves a Life: Stories of Hope from North and South Kivu
author: Every Dollar Saves a Life
description: Stories from North and South Kivu in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Stories of courage, challenges, and hope. Hosted by Bernadette, this podcast shares the mission of Every Dollar Saves a Life and its work to support children and families through education, care, and community support. Listen, learn, and join the mission.

title: Nothing Scary
author: Mike and Tom
description:
Join Mike and Tommy as we review classic and modern horror movies, explore true ghost stories, investigate haunted places, uncover paranormal legends, and talk about everything that goes bump in the night.
Each episode features our unique humor and horror rating system, honest opinions, plenty of laughs, and the occasional unexpected surprise. Whether you're a lifelong horror fan or just enjoy a good spooky story, pull up a chair and join us.
Because around here...
It's absolutely... Nothing Scary.

title: Il tempo in più
author: Chora Media - Daniele Franco
description:
La longevità è entrata nel nostro vocabolario quotidiano, raccontata quasi sempre con entusiasmo e raramente nella sua complessità. Ma vivere più a lungo non è solo una questione di anni in più: è una questione di senso. Che cosa facciamo di questo tempo guadagnato, come lo abitiamo, chi ne beneficia davvero, quali responsabilità comporta.


In questa serie promossa dalla Fondazione Giorgio Cini di Venezia, che ha posto il tema al centro delle sue iniziative per il 2026, Daniele Franco ne parla con alcune delle voci più autorevoli del panorama italiano, scelte  per le angolature diverse da cui la guardano. Perché una società che invecchia non è soltanto una società con più anziani: è una società che cambia il proprio rapporto con il tempo, con la cura e la morte, che si interroga sulla convivenza tra generazioni, sulla trasmissione delle conoscenze e del potere.

title: Dungeons & Drabbles
author: Fast Fantasy Fiction
description:
Fantasy fiction... fast. Step into a world of adventure, conflict, and relationships, where heroes help post-haste. But don't get too comfortable, because these bite-sized episodes are over before they've barely begun. Join the micro fiction revolution with Dungeons and Drabbles. All episodes are exactly 100 words long.

Written and created by longtime podcast storyteller Aaron Robbins, Dungeons and Drabbles is the podcast that started the micro-fiction podcast movement. Episodes run 2 to 3 minutes, seasons run 20 minutes, whether you're working out, driving to work, or just waiting for the drive-through person to take your order, you can finish a fun, part-of-an-ongoing-epic fantasy story without losing your place. So take up your sword, or don't, because by the time you do, the episode will already be over. Enjoy Dungeons and Drabbles today.

title: Love More
author: Kylie Hennessy
description:
Kylie Hennessy explores yoga, love, and all things healing. With nearly 3 decades as a yoga teacher, yoga therapist, and healer, Kylie enjoys conversations with yoginis and yogis, experts, researchers, scientists, therapists, and passionate spiritual seekers. 

This podcast explores topics from biochemistry, birth-death, trauma, therapy, Chinese Medicine, yoga teaching, yoga philosophy, and more.

title: The Generation Jesus Podcast
author: Colton Ellsessor and Nathan White
description: This podcast exists to help you know Jesus, Follow Jesus, and make Jesus Known!

title: Softly Strong
author: Chetna Prabha Anurag
description:
An honest conversation about emotional healing, self-love, and letting go of who you became to please everyone else. Being soft was never the opposite of being strong.
In this episode of Softly Strong, I talk about what it really means to be yourself, not the polished, adjusted, people-pleasing version, but the real one. The one that doesn't shrink to make others comfortable.
This is for anyone who's tired of editing themselves down to fit into rooms, relationships, or expectations that were never really theirs to begin with.
If this resonates, share it with someone who needs the reminder today: you don't have to be less of yourself for anyone.
🎧 New episodes every week.
💬 I'd love to hear your thoughts, find me and share yours.
🤍 Softly Strong

title: KNOW YOUR REAL ENEMY
author: John Godwin Eiza
description:
Text: "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." (Ephesians 6:12 KJV)

Keywords:
1. Wrestle Not
2. Not Flesh
3. Spiritual

Message: 
          Before you wear armour, you must know your enemy. "We wrestle not against flesh and blood." Many of our battles are misdirected. We fight spouses, children, bosses, neighbours, while the real enemy hides behind them. Paul pulls back the curtain: our fight is spiritual. Principalities, powers, rulers of darkness. This does not mean people are not involved, but they are not the source. When you understand this, you stop hating people and start praying against spirits. You stop using carnal weapons and pick up spiritual ones. Victory begins when you fight the right enemy on the right battlefield. Prayer Points:
- Father, open my eyes to see the real battle. - Forgive me for fighting people instead of praying for them. - Teach me to wrestle in the spirit, not in the flesh.

Memory Verse:
"For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." - Ephesians 6:12 KJV

With plenty of laughs, honest conversations and a healthy dose of attitude from the tropics.

title: Victimhood: Five Victims, Five Accounts, One Bloody Mess.
author: Glen Llewellyn
description:
On the morning the Mayor of London unveils the bill that will put the city under AI surveillance, she gives the speech of her life. By that night she is dead, blown apart on the roof of her own hotel with some of the most powerful people in London. Every one of them died believing the bomb was meant for them.
Each will tell their story of what happened that day.
Everyone is the victim in their own story.
An audio novel in five episodes by Glen Llewellyn. 
A Shark Biscuit production.

author: Brooks Newberry

As I grew in my faith, I was a able to start seeing how much Scripture speaks to the practical parts of life too. That’s why I started Build with Christ. We’ll talk about destroying destructive habits, setting and achieving audacious goals, and staying rooted in Christ through it all. I’ll share what I’m learning along the way so you can get the most out of life and let your success honor God.

Subscribe to my free newsletter: fatherthomasletters.com/subscribe. God bless you.

From Ocean City and the Eastern Shore to stories making headlines around the world, The Rude Awakening brings humor, attitude and unmistakable local flavor to your morning. Tune in weekdays on Ocean 98 — The Best of Rock! Online at Ocean98.com!

title: Alex Righetto Art
author: Alex Righetto
description:
Welcome to "Colorful Conversations with Alex Righetto," a captivating podcast that dives deep into the creative mind of an extraordinary Italian artist. Join Alex Righetto, a painter, photographer, and marketer, as he shares his passion for art and storytelling with listeners around the globe.
In each episode, Alex draws from his unique perspective, vibrant color palettes, and dynamic brushwork to explore the emotionally charged narratives behind his paintings. You'll be transported to a world where Italian heritage meets contemporary art, as Alex reinterprets elements from Italian and Europe

title: Hope Has A Voice Podcast
author: Jenni Eastin, PhD
description: Are you ready to be inspired?  Do you need to be reminded of God's goodness and hear stories of His faithfulness?  If so, you have found a great place to camp.  In every story, you will hear words of hope that will encourage you to stay in the game, finish the race, and trust the God who has promised hope for your future.

FOUND with Trish and Sherri — Everybody Has a Story.
Real conversations about family, identity, DNA, adoption, reunion, discovery—and the moments that change everything.

title: Unpacking with Michelle
author: Michelle Raney
description: Unpacking with Michelle is where real life gets unpacked — the healing, the chaos, the breakthroughs, the spiritual awakenings, and all the messy shit in between. Michelle brings raw conversations, lived experience, humor, and hard-earned wisdom to the mic without pretending to have it all figured out. Nothing is off the table. We unpack it, learn from it, laugh when we can, and keep evolving.

title: We Said What We Said
author: We Said What We Said
description:
We Said What We Said is a show where Gilbert Arenas, Nick Young, and Melli Monaco bring unfiltered opinions, hilarious conversations, wild stories, celebrity drama, viral moments, sports, culture, and everything happening in the world.
Nothing is off limits.
From the biggest celebrity headlines and the craziest videos taking over the internet to sports, relationships, community issues, politics, world news, and the conversations everyone is having — we break it all down with our own unique perspective.

title: Don’t Try This Pod At Home
author: Don’t Try This Pod At Home
description: Inside the boiler room Don’t Try This Pod talks about this week in WWE while doing the unthinkable, sharing our fantasy bookings, and what we love about sports entertainment! Make sure to check in and see what guests we have on for exclusive interviews.

title: Caregiving Reimagined
author: Dr. Claudia Bennett
description: My name is Dr. Claudia Cassidy Bennett. I've spent over 40 years as an occupational therapist, the last 15 working specifically with family caregivers navigating one of life's most demanding journeys. I've also lived this alongside you, caring for my own mother through Alzheimer's. I've learned what caregivers actually need: practical help, honest support, and someone who genuinely gets it. Until you’re part of the club, it’s hard to understand. We'll tackle the everyday challenges — bathing, dressing, feeding, toileting, medication management, and doctors’ appointments. We'll go deep into the emotional and spiritual side of caregiving that rarely gets talked about. You'll hear real stories from real caregivers. And yes — we'll laugh too. At the missteps, at the unexpected things our loved ones do, at the moments that are equal parts exhausting and absurd. The good, the bad, and the ugly. Because caregiving can be a messy job — physically and emotionally. Caregiving is not just something that happens to you. It is an opportunity to strengthen your relationship with your loved one, to deepen your spirituality, and to discover a level of self-awareness you never knew was possible. Being the caregiver you want to be — and are proud to be.

title: Think Like An Economist
author: iHeartPodcasts
description: Think Like an Economist and you'll see the world more clearly, empowering you to make better decisions at work, at home, and in your community. Leading economists Betsey Stevenson and Justin Wolfers will take you on a joyous romp through their field as they introduce you to the big ideas in economics, and show how you can apply them to live in your own life. Their signature approach reveals that every decision is an economic decision and this podcast uncovers the economic forces that shape the world around you. Betsey and Justin believe that economics is a superpower, and they want to teach you to fly.

title: The Loveable Losers
author: The Loveable Losers
description: Where Vikings, Raiders, and Gambling fans complain about the NFL, chase props, ruin their fantasy lineups, and somehow come back for more everytime.

title: What’s the Next Smallest Step?
author: Shauna Garvey
description: What’s the Next Smallest Step? is a podcast about lifestyle medicine, positive health, and the small habits and bigger ideas that change a life. Positive Health Coach Shauna Garvey talks to people about their real experiences of change - what prompted it, what helped, what got in the way, and what they learned along the way. Different conversations, different stories, all circling the same question: what’s the next smallest step?

title: Twilight Radio
author: SuperDifferent.com
description: SuperDifferent.com presents a podcast like no other—featuring Christian messages, scripture, prayer, poetry, and more to fuel your faith. In a world clouded by fear and moral darkness, recharge with hope and courage. You’ll also journey alongside Hanaya Oki, a teenage girl in Japan, as she navigates life with Jesus from her early to late teens. Though fictional, Hanaya is inspired by real teens of faith, and her story sparks deeper conversations about choices, purpose, and eternal perspective. Each episode draws you into her world while inviting you to look deeper into your own.

title: Do You Have The Equipment?
author: Crystal Richards
description:
Three friends since the 90s (don't do the math) get together to talk about life, love, and whether you've got the equipment to handle it all. From 90s nostalgia, pop culture, and to modern-day survival, we're figuring it out one episode at a time, with plenty of laughs and zero shame. #3C (Crystal Cringe City)

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Source - An AI Deep Dive Podcast
author: The Source AI Podcast
description:
A weekly discussion of how AI moves from strategy to adoption.
Each episode begins with a Source (a concept, a decision, news, etc), and deep dives on what it reveals about how AI reshapes leadership, operations, and governance.
Hosted by Jane Context, who brings the strategic lens and frames the “why it matters,” and Mike Loop, who grounds every discussion in iteration, execution, and real‑world adoption.

Every Monday a new episode https://thesourceaideepdive.netlify.app/

title: Encore: The Best is Yet to Come
author: Susannah Schofield OBE | Author, Entrepreneur & Host
description:
What happens when life gives you an Encore?
Hosted by Susannah Schofield OBE, Encore: The Best is Yet to Come is about what comes next, and making it count. Each week, Susannah sits down with a new guest, from leading experts and familiar faces to people with extraordinary real-life stories, for honest conversations about relationships, reinvention, confidence, health, intimacy, success and starting again.
No filters. No judgement. Just real people, real advice and the conversations we should be having after 40.
Your next chapter could be your best one yet!

title: Treat It Or Train It
author: Justin Harris and Justin Feldman
description: Treat It or Train It? is the show for anyone caught between the foam roller and the finish line. Each week, physical therapist Dr. Justin Feldman, PT, DPT (Feldman Physical Therapy & Performance) and endurance coach Justin Harris (jHarris Coaching) take real questions from listeners — submitted as video — and settle the debate: is this an injury to treat, or a limitation to train through? One clinical eye, one performance eye, one verdict, every week on Spotify, YouTube, and Apple Podcasts. Got a nagging ache or a training plateau? Send us your video question — we might use it on the show

title: The Reconciliation Podcast
author: Bella K
description:
Bella K is a reconciliation, relationship and embodiment coach and host of The Reconciliation Podcast, exploring whether reconciliation is truly possible and how to navigate the moments when it feels like it's slipping away.
Having reconciled with her own ex-husband five years post-separation and three years post-divorce, Bella teaches a different path back - not tactics or a 10-step plan, but embodiment, nervous system regulation and becoming the person with whom reconciliation is possible.
Wherever you are, if you're in the thick of it, you're in the right place.

title: Born Between The Lines: Lucy’s Adoption Story
author: Queen Ethelburga’s Studios
description: What do you say to the parents you've never met? Lucy was adopted as a baby, and when she turned 18 she decided to find out. In Born Between the Lines, a five-part series made by two students in Queen Ethelburga's studio in York, she tells her own adoption story. She also sits down with other adopted people, parents and the professionals who bring families together, to talk honestly about identity, belonging and the comments nobody should have to hear. Each episode ends with a letter to her birth parents, and by the finale that letter has been answered.

title: Field To Yield: Crops & Comments
author: Geoff Reeves

The Open Chair is a conversation podcast with Mike & Sarah, where creators, founders, students, artists, researchers, athletes, and people with a story worth hearing take a seat to share their ideas and experiences. Each episode explores their story, their work, the choices they’ve made, and what they’ve learned along the way. No perfect answers—just thoughtful, personal conversations about what people are building, learning, and becoming.

title: Recovery Didn't Explain This
author: RayBlanco5150
description:
Recovery gave me a way out...but it didn’t explain everything.
Recovery Didn’t Explain This takes an unflinching look at addiction, prison, loneliness, trauma, identity, and the parts of survival that conventional recovery conversations often leave untouched. This isn’t another collection of slogans or simple answers. It’s an honest investigation into why people use, what drugs may have been doing for them, and what remains after the drugs are gone.
For anyone who got clean and discovered that addiction wasn’t even half the problem...and anyone willing to see recovery from a different angle.

title: The Marriage Reset Podcast
author: Coach Tom
description:
For the husband trying to save his marriage while his wife is already halfway out the door.
If she's gone cold, asked for space, or started talking about divorce, the instinct is to chase, plead, and fix everything at once, and that usually makes it worse. Each episode, Tom gets straight to it: what's really going on in her head, what you're doing that's pushing her away, and the calm, grounded moves that give your marriage a real chance.
Part of Marriage Reset. New episodes every Friday.

Every episode Matt will be joined by a guest, who will bring with them their favorite spooky episode of a TV show , and together they will watch it and discuss it. 
New episodes every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday during October. 
Join us... if you dare!

title: MIT OpenCourseWare: Free Courses from the institute
author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description:
A free and open online publication of educational material from thousands of MIT courses, covering the entire MIT curriculum, ranging from introductory to the most advanced graduate courses. On the OCW website, each course includes a syllabus, instructional material like notes and reading lists, and learning activities like assignments and solutions. Some courses also have videos, online textbooks, and faculty insights on teaching.

Knowledge is your reward. There's no signup or enrollment, and no start or end dates. OCW is self-paced learning at its best.

Whether you’re a student, a teacher, or simply a curious person that wants to learn, MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW) offers a wealth of insight, inspiration, videos, and a whole lot more!

description: The Human Element explores who we are through four unique lenses: People, Ideas, Beliefs, and Stories. title: FrenchTober : October French Writing Challenge
author: Better French Speaking with Laetitia Perraut
description:
Every day in October, one short prompt to get you writing in French.
You understand French, but when it’s time to speak, the words don’t come together? Writing is the answer. Building good sentences on paper is how you learn to build them out loud: better writing leads to better speaking.
Inspired by Inktober, FrenchTober is a 31-day challenge for learners from A2 to C1. Each episode lasts no more than a minute and a half: listen to the day’s prompt, then write. This year’s theme is cooking. We start gently, with a single sentence a day in the first week, then build up step by step until you’re writing a full text in the final week.
Hosted by Laetitia, who has been creating One Thing In A French Day for 20 years.
Starts on 1 October. More at www.onethinginafrenchday.com
La bonne syntaxe, et votre français est au max !

title: LDS Storytime
author: Rachel Uda Murdock
description:
LDS Storytime shares short, remarkable stories of faith from members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints around the world. Discover inspiring accounts of miracles, conversion, sacrifice, Church history, missionary work, and ordinary people experiencing God in extraordinary ways. Hosted by Rachel Uda Murdock, each episode points listeners toward Jesus Christ through published histories, firsthand accounts, and personal experiences. 
Independent and not affiliated with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

Through cases, ideas and conversations with analysts, strategists and multidisciplinary thinkers, it looks beyond the surface of events to uncover the forces, languages and narratives shaping them.
Behind every message lies a strategy, behind every strategy, a War Room.
A new episode every month.

​Whether you are commuting to rotations, reviewing between shifts, or locking in core facts for your next test, tune in for rapid, clear, and high-impact medical

title: Healing Uncovered
author: Jennifer Watson
description: Welcome to Healing Uncovered, where real people, powerful stories, and mental health experts come together to remind us that healing isn’t perfect, but it’s always possible. Join hosts Jennifer Watson and Chandler Goff as they have honest conversations about mental health, the science behind healing, and the real-life experiences that shape us all.
